challenges.title: Living Archives: Generative AI for Indigenous Mural & Fresco Restoration
challenges.shortDescription: Develop algorithmic neural inpainting and color palette synthesis to restore weathered temple frescoes while preserving sacred geometric proportions.
challenges.background: Centuries-old Kerala and South Indian mural art forms are deteriorating due to humidity, age, and exposure. Traditional natural pigments (ochre, indigo, lime, lampblack) possess unique spectral properties rarely captured accurately by standard digital colorizers.
challenges.problemDescription: Design a computer vision or generative pipeline that reconstructs damaged sections of heritage murals. The system must adhere to traditional iconometric canons (Dhyana Slokas and Talmana measurements) rather than generating unconstrained modern imagery.
objectives: Implement non-destructive digital inpainting of eroded fresco boundaries.
Recreate authentic historical mineral and vegetal dye palettes based on historical pigments.
Provide an interactive comparative viewer contrasting raw archives with restored states.
expectedOutcomes: A functional prototype web or desktop tool for conservators and cultural historians.
Clear visual attribution documentation demonstrating adherence to traditional artistic rules.
constraints: Must not alter uncorrupted historical strokes.
Must operate with low-resource training datasets typical of localized heritage.
challenges.submissionGuidance: Include raw sample inputs, restoration comparisons, architecture diagram, and GitHub repository.

challenges.title: Symphony of Mudras: Real-time Computer Vision for Classical Dance Synthesis
challenges.shortDescription: Capture, classify, and sonify classical Indian dance mudras (hand gestures) and footwork rhythms in real-time using pose estimation.
challenges.background: Classical dance forms such as Kathakali, Bharatanatyam, and Mohiniyattam encode rich linguistic and rhythmic narratives through complex hand gestures (Hastas) and facial expressions (Navarasas).
challenges.problemDescription: Build a multimodal creative experience that translates live or recorded performance gestures into dynamic visual particles, responsive kinetic typography, or generative generative soundscapes.
objectives: Achieve real-time classification of at least 15 primary Asamyutta and Samyutta Hastas.
Generate aesthetic visual and auditory responses matching the emotional Bhavas.
Offer educational feedback for students learning classical posture alignment.
expectedOutcomes: An interactive web application operating via standard webcam without specialized hardware.
Interactive tutorial mode visualizing skeletal joints and accuracy metrics.
challenges.submissionGuidance: Provide 3-5 minute demonstration video demonstrating gesture recognition and aesthetic feedback.

challenges.title: Kalam & Code: Dynamic Typography Engine for Dravidian Calligraphy
challenges.shortDescription: Reimagine ancient palm-leaf scriptures and classical script ligatures as a modern responsive generative typography and vector system.
challenges.background: Grantha, Vatteluttu, and archaic Malayalam scripts were historically incised using an iron stylus (Narayam) onto dried Palmyra leaves. The rounded curves evolved specifically to avoid tearing the leaf along its grain.
challenges.problemDescription: Build an algorithmic font generator or vector layout engine that renders fluid, calligraphic letterforms responding to digital parameters (speed, stylus pressure, screen physics, or user interaction).
objectives: Mathematical modeling of the nib angle, pressure dynamics, and ink bleed physics.
Support for complex conjunct consonants and historical ligature variants.
Interactive digital exhibition showing the evolution from palm-leaf incision to generative code.
expectedOutcomes: Exportable SVG/Canvas font or interactive digital canvas for contemporary designers.
Educational narrative explaining the historical material constraints.
challenges.submissionGuidance: Link to interactive demo URL and GitHub repo with documented geometric curve calculations.

challenges.title: Woven Geometry: Algorithmic Loom & Pattern Synthesis for Traditional Handloom
challenges.shortDescription: Translate mathematical fractals, cellular automata, and heritage weaving graphs into automated punch-card templates for weaver communities.
challenges.background: Traditional handloom weaving (e.g. Kasavu borders, Balaramapuram weaves) utilizes binary warp/weft matrices that are direct historical precursors to modern computational punch cards.
challenges.problemDescription: Develop an accessible digital design suite that bridges contemporary computational art algorithms with the practical warp/weft constraints of rural handloom weavers.
objectives: Interactive pattern designer generating cellular automata or fractal motifs.
Automated conversion into real-world weave draft charts (lifting plans and tie-up matrices).
Cost and yarn requirement estimator for artisan cooperatives.
expectedOutcomes: Web-based pattern generator with instant exportable weaver draft sheets.
Artisanal preview displaying high-resolution textile texture rendering.
challenges.submissionGuidance: Demonstrate the mathematical algorithm and generated weaver draft chart.

challenges.title: Temple of Resonance: Spatial Audio & Interactive Web AR for Heritage Architecture
challenges.shortDescription: Construct an immersive 3D/WebXR digital museum replicating the acoustic reverberation and tactile architecture of historic stone structures.
challenges.background: Traditional South Indian temple halls feature musical stone pillars and specific acoustic geometry designed to amplify Vedic chanting and percussion resonance.
challenges.problemDescription: Create a lightweight, browser-based WebXR or 3D interactive heritage exhibition allowing visitors to experience the acoustics, structural lighting, and cultural artifacts remotely.
objectives: Implement Web Audio API spatial acoustic impulse responses matching stone sanctuaries.
Responsive 3D or WebGL architectural viewer optimized for mobile devices.
Curated digital artifact hotspots with audio-visual narrative storytelling.
expectedOutcomes: Performant 3D exhibition accessible without requiring app installation.
Interactive acoustic resonance simulation when interacting with virtual architectural elements.
challenges.submissionGuidance: Submit hosted demo link and Google Drive walk-through video.

submissions.challengeTitle: Living Archives: Generative AI for Indigenous Mural & Fresco Restoration
submissions.projectTitle: ChitraPunar: Neural Fresco Inpainting with Mineral Pigment Physics
submissions.shortDescription: An intelligent restoration pipeline synthesizing lost temple mural contours with authentic mineral pigments and Dhyana Sloka proportion safeguards.
submissions.problemDescription: Historical temple frescoes across Kerala face severe dampness erosion. Traditional artists used vegetable dyes and stone powders that follow strict iconography guidelines, which modern diffusion models distort without cultural constraints.
submissions.proposedSolution: We trained a lightweight edge-constrained latent inpainting network conditioned on classical Talmana ratio vectors. Our custom shaders simulate authentic vermilion, lampblack, and yellow ochre light scattering.
keyFeatures: Dual-stream latent inpainting respecting traditional iconographic line geometry
Spectral simulation of 5 sacred Ayurvedic mineral pigments
Interactive 4K dual-layer comparative web inspection tool
Confidence heatmaps indicating restored vs. historically authentic strokes
submissions.innovationAndImpact: Bridges centuries-old craftsmanship with modern non-destructive archival restoration, enabling regional heritage trusts to digitize endangered temple murals.
submissions.additionalComments: Demo video contains audio explanation in English and Malayalam.
